newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunkers steady in sleepy start to week.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers steady in sleepy start to week.

text.p: Bunker prices in European ports were little changed on Monday after a long weekend in southern Europe and little ARA barge market movement.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil bunkers were quoted at around $97/$98 fob as the barge market registered little more than an early trade at $94.50 ex wharf.
Enquiries were at a very low level, under 10,000 tonnes by most estimates.
Hamburg prices were also steady, at about $2 above the benchmark Rotterdam quote.
The Mediterranean market barely awoke with low volumes following a three-day weekend in most countries in the region.
